name: @pipeworx/mcp-string-db

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Map free-text identifiers (gene symbols, accessions) → STRING identifiers.

tools.name: interactions
tools.description: Interaction partners for a set of proteins.

tools.name: network
tools.description: Network image url + tabular interaction data.

tools.name: enrichment
tools.description: Functional enrichment (GO, KEGG, Pfam, Reactome, …) for a gene set.

tools.name: homology
tools.description: Retrieve STRING-DB homology mappings for a list of protein identifiers (gene symbols or accessions) within a given NCBI taxonomy species (default 9606=human), returning cross-species homolog relationships.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-string-db forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the string-db pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
